g.text: Manufacturing first-ST prediction: descriptive accuracy–complexity frontier
Three-seed means and min–max ranges, not confidence intervals. Blue: CIF functions; gold: log-odds functions + logistic link.
Only frozen configurations; EBM fixed-round fits overfit (not tuned-baseline superiority). Previously exposed data, PROVISIONAL.
Reference lines have no claimed global function-table size.
